title: ChatGPT split 3 ways and it's actually genius
description:
ChatGPT just split into three models, Sol, Terra, and Luna, and each one is for a different job. Here is a plain-English breakdown of what ChatGPT's new GPT-5.6 models do, when to use each, and what they really cost, so you stop overpaying or waiting around. Sol is the heavy model for deep research and hard problems, Terra is the balanced everyday model, and Luna is the fastest and cheapest for quick tasks.

#Shorts #ChatGPT #ai 

Get the cheat sheet on all three models here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rYPbkhC69c2NNRfX_yhWSFfAl2AhNP8Kkw2RCIK07C4/edit?usp=sharing
